dossier.purpose: Loki is Grafana Labs' multi-tenant log-aggregation server written in Go: one binary whose roles are chosen with `-target` (default `all` = single-binary mode). It indexes only per-stream label sets, stores compressed log chunks plus 'structured metadata' on the local filesystem or object storage, ingests logs through its push API (`/loki/api/v1/push`) and an OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint (`/otlp/v1/logs`), and answers LogQL queries over an HTTP API and `logcli`. Facts that bear on the stated needs: (1) Loki is not a collector or privacy filter - the README names Grafana Alloy (a separate repo) as the agent; Loki's own OTLP path can only drop attributes or map them to index labels / structured metadata, and it stores the log body verbatim; (2) there is no OTLP metrics receiver and no metrics store (OTLP logs only; recording rules can remote-write to a Prometheus-compatible backend); (3) OTLP log records are stored as logs and are queryable locally with LogQL; (4) Loki has no log-exploration or dashboard UI of its own (docs defer to Grafana, a separate project; the in-repo 'Loki UI' is an experimental, off-by-default deployment-operations UI); (5) there is no trace store, dataset/experiment store or LLM-evaluation tooling; (6) there is no model-serving/inference code and no GPU use.

claims.claim: Loki is 'a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus', designed to be 'very cost effective and easy to operate'.
It 'does not index the contents of the logs, but rather a set of labels for each log stream' (no full-text indexing; compressed, unstructured logs plus a metadata index).

Loki 'has native support in Grafana (needs Grafana v6.0)'; a Loki-based stack is Alloy (agent that gathers logs and sends them to Loki) + Loki (stores logs, processes queries) + Grafana (querying and displaying the logs).
'Alloy replaced Promtail in the stack, because Promtail is considered to be feature complete'; future log-collection development is in Grafana Alloy.
Loki wants 'a single-binary, easy to operate system with no dependencies' and differs from Prometheus 'by focusing on logs instead of metrics, and delivering logs via push, instead of pull'.
Helm chart migration: effective March 16, 2026 the Loki Helm chart is forked to grafana-community/helm-charts; the chart in the Loki repo stays maintained for GEL users only.

Doc entry points: API docs 'for getting logs into Loki'; LogCLI 'provides a command-line interface for querying logs'; Loki Canary 'monitors your Loki installation for missing logs'; Docker driver client sends container logs to Loki.
Build from source: `go build ./cmd/loki` then `./loki -config.file=./cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml` ('single host, no-dependencies mode'); on Unix `make loki` builds ./cmd/loki/loki.
Multi-tenant local run: set auth_enabled true and use `-config.file=./cmd/loki/loki-local-multi-tenant-config.yaml -runtime-config.file=./cmd/loki/loki-overrides.yaml`.
License: 'Grafana Loki is distributed under AGPL-3.0-only (LICENSE). For Apache-2.0 exceptions, see LICENSING.md.'
A fuzzing-status badge (OSS-Fuzz project loki) and a CI badge for the `check` workflow are shown.

readme.telemetry_and_network: Usage reporting ('analytics') is ON by default: Loki POSTs a JSON report to https://stats.grafana.org/loki-usage-report every 4h (pkg/analytics/stats.go:26,75-99; pkg/analytics/reporter.go:44-45,61-62). The report carries a random persistent cluster UID (seed file loki_cluster_seed.json written to the configured object store; reporter.go:36,136-139,285-291), version, OS/arch, target, edition 'oss', Go memstats, CPU/goroutine counts and aggregate counters/strings registered via analytics.New* (ingested bytes/lines, store/index/schema types, compactor retention settings, query throughput; e.g. pkg/loghttp/push/push.go:73-75, pkg/storage/store.go:51-53, pkg/compactor/compactor.go:78-79, pkg/analytics/stats.go:61-72,102-169). Docs say it excludes log payloads, label values, tenant identifiers and query strings (docs/sources/configure/usage-statistics.md:21); no log content is registered in the stats I found. Opt-out: `analytics.reporting_enabled: false` or `-reporting.enabled=false` (usage-statistics.md:25-36); knobs -reporting.proxy-url and -reporting.tls-config.* (reporter.go:62-64). The shipped configs only comment out the opt-out (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:54-65), and that same file is packaged as /etc/loki/config.yml in deb/rpm (tools/packaging/nfpm.jsonnet:25-29). When the UI ring is enabled, GET /analytics returns the report that would be sent (pkg/analytics/handler.go:21-32; pkg/loki/modules.go:2303). Own tracing: tracing.enabled defaults true (pkg/tracing/config.go:12) but spans are exported only if JAEGER_* / OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER / OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_(TRACES_)ENDPOINT env vars are set (vendor/github.com/grafana/dskit/tracing/otel_jaeger.go:55-69). Loki serves Prometheus metrics for pull at /metrics (docs/sources/reference/loki-http-api.md:60). golang.org/x/telemetry appears only as an indirect dependency of vendored x/tools goimports (go.mod:332; no Loki code imports it). Only hard-coded external endpoint in non-test pkg code is the usage-stats URL. No account, license key or SaaS service is required: the single binary runs with filesystem storage and an in-memory ring (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:9-19); object storage, Alertmanager (ruler.alertmanager_url, :47-48), memcached and Kafka are optional. Network exposure: HTTP listen address defaults to all interfaces (vendor/github.com/grafana/dskit/server/server.go:193), Loki sets port 3100 (pkg/loki/loki.go:259-260), gRPC 9095 (server.go:209; local config uses 9096); no built-in authentication (docs/sources/setup/install/local.md:20); auth.enabled defaults true and then requires X-Scope-OrgID (pkg/loki/loki.go:159-162). README.md (read in full) does not mention usage reporting, OTLP, MCP or GPUs.

code.architecture: One Go module (github.com/grafana/loki/v3, go.mod:1) produces a `loki` binary whose roles are chosen with `-target` (default `all`; aliases read/write/backend and individual services; module/dependency table at pkg/loki/loki.go:149-158,810-866; route registration and init in pkg/loki/modules.go) on grafana/dskit services, rings and memberlist. Write path: pkg/distributor/http.go handlers parse push and OTLP requests through pkg/loghttp/push (push.go, otlp.go, otlp_config.go) -> pkg/distributor -> pkg/ingester (WAL + pkg/chunkenc chunks) -> chunk store on filesystem/object storage via pkg/storage with a TSDB label index (pkg/storage/stores/shipper/indexshipper/tsdb; index.go:407 AddSeries stores label sets + chunk metadata, not line contents). Read path: pkg/lokifrontend + pkg/scheduler + pkg/querier evaluate LogQL (pkg/logql; grammar pkg/logql/syntax/syntax.y). Background services: pkg/compactor (compaction, retention, delete API), pkg/ruler (alert/recording rules; recording rules remote-write to Prometheus-compatible backends, docs/sources/operations/recording-rules.md:9,17), pkg/pattern (pattern ingester + metric aggregation pushed back to a Loki address, pkg/pattern/aggregation/config.go:13). Experimental subsystems (category experimental in pkg/loki/loki.go:95,105-106,117-122): pkg/engine (v2 query engine), pkg/dataobj (columnar data objects), pkg/bloombuild + pkg/bloomgateway, pkg/kafka ingestion, pkg/limits. Cross-cutting: pkg/validation (per-tenant limits incl. otlp_config), pkg/analytics (usage reporting), pkg/ui (experimental deployment UI, off by default), pkg/tracing. Apache-2.0 subtrees (LICENSING.md:9-22): clients/ (Docker driver, Fluent Bit plugin, a Promtail library without a main package, Ruby fluentd/logstash plugins), pkg/push, pkg/loghttp, pkg/logproto, pkg/util, production/ (Helm chart, ksonnet, mixins), tools/.
code.packaging_and_release: Artifacts: `make dist` cross-builds loki, logcli, loki-canary and lokitool with CGO_ENABLED=0 for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, linux/arm, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, windows/amd64 and freebsd/amd64 (SKIP_ARM=false in release jobs), zips each as <bin>-<os>-<arch>.zip and writes dist/SHA256SUMS (Makefile:317-334; .github/workflows/patch-release-pr.yml:118-139). `make packages` adds .deb/.rpm for loki, loki-canary and logcli on amd64/arm64/arm (tools/packaging/nfpm.sh:7-13); the loki package ships /usr/bin/loki, a systemd unit and /etc/loki/config.yml, and its post-install script enables and restarts the service (tools/packaging/nfpm.jsonnet:14-34; tools/packaging/loki-postinstall.sh:26-33). OCI images (distroless static:nonroot, UID 10001; cmd/loki/Dockerfile:20-32): loki, logcli, loki-canary(+boringcrypto) and helm-test for linux/amd64,arm64,arm; querytee and the Docker driver for amd64,arm64; fluentd/fluent-bit/logstash plugin images for amd64 (.github/release-workflows.jsonnet:18-35). Flow: release-please PR workflows (.github/workflows/minor-release-pr.yml, patch-release-pr.yml) build into Google Artifact Registry; .github/workflows/release.yml (push to main, release-X.Y.x, kN: release.yml:397-402) creates a DRAFT GitHub release via release-please, uploads dist/* (release.yml:96-120), publishes images to a GAR mirror (us-docker.pkg.dev/grafanalabs-global/dockerhub-loki-prod-mirror; release.yml:7-8,287-327) and then un-drafts it (release.yml:356-358). Integrity: SHA256SUMS only; no cosign/sigstore/GPG/SLSA-attestation step found in .github or tools; weekly image builds set `provenance: true` (.github/vendor/github.com/grafana/loki-release/workflows/build.libsonnet:144; .github/workflows/images.yml:85) and .github/workflows/syft-sbom-ci.yml creates an SPDX SBOM when a release is created (:22-25); release notes template has no verification instructions (tools/release-note.md). Reusable check/release logic lives in grafana/loki-release pinned at 6cba58c3... (release.yml:10; check.yml:3), outside this tree, so what it signs is not checkable here. At tag v3.7.8, .release-please-manifest.json:2 and CHANGELOG.md:3 still read 3.7.7. Docs also list Helm ('recommended') and Tanka for Kubernetes (docs/sources/setup/install/_index.md:12-18), but the Helm chart is no longer released from this repo (production/helm/loki/Chart.yaml:5-6 = chart 6.55.0 / appVersion 3.6.7; README.md:38-39). A Nix flake builds loki/logcli/loki-canary for developers (nix/README.md:13-24; .github/workflows/nix-ci.yaml:42-44).
code.tests_and_ci: Go `testing` + testify (go.mod:94), goleak (go.mod:99), gotestsum in CI. 835 `*_test.go` files outside vendor/ (pkg 734 incl. pkg/push, clients 82, integration 11, tools 5, production 2, cmd 1) plus 3 Ruby spec files under clients/cmd. `make test` runs `go test ./...` with coverage (Makefile:378-379); the integration suite is behind `//go:build integration` and runs via `make test-integration` (integration/*.go; Makefile:382-383), including an OTLP ingest+query test (integration/loki_micro_services_test.go:659; helper integration/client/client.go:180-226). Fuzzing: `make test-fuzz` (Makefile:717-720) and an OSS-Fuzz badge (README.md:6). LogQL benchmark/correctness harness in pkg/logql/bench (pkg/logql/bench/README.md:3,42). CI (.github/workflows): check.yml calls the reusable grafana/loki-release check workflow (check.yml:3) which, per the vendored source (.github/vendor/github.com/grafana/loki-release/workflows/validate.libsonnet:36-243), runs golangci-lint (v2.10.1 per .github/release-workflows.jsonnet:9), faillint, `make check-generated-files / check-mod / check-doc / validate-example-configs`, lint-scripts, check-format, per-package `gotestsum -tags=assert`, the pkg/push module tests, the integration tests and a docs-site build; build-loki-binary.yml cross-builds linux/amd64,arm64,arm on PRs; helm-ci.yml and helm-diff-ci.yml (Helm chart), lint-jsonnet.yml, nix-ci.yaml, logql-correctness.yml (schedule/PR), logql-bench.yml (manual), conventional-commits.yml, verify-release-workflow.yaml, secret-scanning.yml (TruffleHog), snyk.yml (Snyk monitor), relyance.yml (daily), images.yml and querytee-images.yml (image publish), plus the release workflows. All runners are Linux (ubuntu-x64/ubuntu-arm64; no macOS or Windows runner found).

claim_checks.claim: Loki focuses on logs and takes data by push (README.md:29-30). The README never mentions OTLP; docs add 'Loki natively supports ingesting OpenTelemetry logs over HTTP' (docs/sources/shared/otel.md:20).
claim_checks.evidence: pkg/loki/modules.go:420-422 registers POST /api/prom/push, /loki/api/v1/push and /otlp/v1/logs behind tenant + ingestion-policy middleware (:405-412; paths in pkg/util/constants/api_paths.go:33,44). The OTLP parser handles only the logs signal (plogotlp.NewExportRequest, pkg/loghttp/push/otlp.go:118), content types application/x-protobuf or application/json by exact header match (:120-138; the native push path strips media-type parameters via mime.ParseMediaType at pkg/loghttp/push/push.go:363, the OTLP path does not) and Content-Encoding gzip/zstd/lz4/none (:69-101). A search of non-vendor Go code found no pmetricotlp/ptraceotlp/otlpreceiver or OTLP collector gRPC stubs, so there is no OTLP metrics, traces or gRPC ingestion. OTLP/structured metadata also requires schema v13 + TSDB index or startup validation fails (pkg/loki/validation.go:39-52). With the default auth.enabled=true a request without X-Scope-OrgID gets 401 (pkg/loki/loki.go:159-162; docs/sources/operations/multi-tenancy.md:25); the shipped local config sets auth_enabled: false, tenant 'fake' (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:1). OTLP ingest+query is exercised by integration/loki_micro_services_test.go:659.

claim_checks.claim: 'a single-binary, easy to operate system with no dependencies'; run `go build ./cmd/loki` with loki-local-config.yaml (README.md:29,98-112).
claim_checks.evidence: cmd/loki/main.go is the server main and the default target is `all` (pkg/loki/loki.go:149-150); the config uses filesystem chunks/rules, in-memory ring KV, tsdb/v13 schema and no external service (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:9-19,32-40). Caveats found in the same file: usage reporting to stats.grafana.org stays enabled (:54-65), an optional Alertmanager URL is listed (:47-48), the pattern ingester with metric aggregation pushes to localhost:3100 (:42-45; pkg/pattern/aggregation/config.go:13), data goes under /tmp/loki (:9-15) and log_level is debug (:6).

claim_checks.claim: Loki 'does not index the contents of the logs, but rather a set of labels for each log stream' (README.md:12,16).
claim_checks.evidence: The TSDB index writer stores a label set + fingerprint with chunk metadata (min/max time, checksum), not line text (pkg/storage/stores/shipper/indexshipper/tsdb/index/index.go:407-420,511-517); lines and structured metadata live in chunks (pkg/chunkenc/memchunk.go); the shipped schema is tsdb/v13 (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:32-40). Exception: experimental bloom-filter build/gateway components accelerate content filters (pkg/loki/loki.go:105-106 category experimental; docs/sources/release-notes/v3-0.md:21).

claim_checks.claim: 'Alloy replaced Promtail in the stack, because Promtail is considered to be feature complete' (README.md:27).
claim_checks.evidence: Docs and code differ from the README: docs say 'Promtail is end of life (EOL) as of March 2, 2026. Commercial support has ended. No future support or updates will be provided' (docs/sources/send-data/promtail/_index.md:12). There is no clients/cmd/promtail entry point in the tree (clients/cmd holds only docker-driver, fluent-bit, fluentd, logstash) and the Makefile has no promtail build target (Makefile:125-138,180-281), although the Apache-licensed library code clients/pkg/promtail remains. The part about Alloy being the agent is consistent with docs/sources/send-data/_index.md:21.

claim_checks.claim: Loki 'has native support in Grafana (needs Grafana v6.0)' (README.md:19).
claim_checks.evidence: Grafana is a separate repository. Docs differ from the README on the version: 'Grafana versions after 6.3 have built-in support' and 'Grafana Loki does not have its own user interface' (docs/sources/visualize/grafana.md:17). In-repo integration tests exercise Loki APIs used by exploration UIs (integration/explore_logs_test.go:31-60), not Grafana itself.

claim_checks.claim: Docs: 'When running Loki as a docker container, the UI service is enabled by default. No additional configuration is required.' (docs/sources/operations/loki-ui/_index.md:31)
claim_checks.evidence: Code wins: -ui.enabled defaults to false (pkg/ui/config.go:55; docs/sources/shared/configuration.md:115), initUIRing/initUI return nil unless enabled (pkg/loki/modules.go:2272-2274,2323-2326), the Docker image CMD only sets -config.file (cmd/loki/Dockerfile:32) and cmd/loki/loki-docker-config.yaml has no ui block; only the Helm chart turns it on via values (production/helm/loki/values.yaml:340-341). claim_checks.claim: Docs: OTLP data maps to Loki so that 'Everything under LogRecord except LogRecord.Body, LogRecord.TimeUnixNano and sometimes LogRecord.ObservedTimestamp' becomes structured metadata, and 17 default resource attributes become index labels (docs/sources/shared/otel.md:87-104,118-121; docs/sources/send-data/otel/_index.md:33).
claim_checks.evidence: Code stores the body verbatim as the line (pkg/loghttp/push/otlp.go:577), log attributes per otlp_config actions (:489-514), severity number/text, observed_timestamp, dropped_attributes_count, flags, trace_id, span_id (:519-573) and scope name/version/dropped count + scope attributes (:322-339). But LogRecord.EventName (present in vendored pdata: vendor/go.opentelemetry.io/collector/pdata/plog/generated_logrecord.go:150) is never read - no EventName reference exists under pkg/, cmd/, integration/ or docs/. risks: Scope: the only OTLP path is POST /otlp/v1/logs over HTTP (pkg/loki/modules.go:422; parser pkg/loghttp/push/otlp.go:118). No OTLP metrics, traces or gRPC receiver exists in non-vendor code, and the project has no metrics store, trace store, dataset/experiment store or model serving (README.md:29-30; docs/sources/get-started/overview.md:13). The OTLP Content-Type must match exactly application/x-protobuf or application/json (otlp.go:120-138), and OTLP/structured metadata needs schema v13 + TSDB or startup validation errors (pkg/loki/validation.go:39-52). LogRecord.EventName is not stored although docs say all LogRecord fields are kept (docs/sources/shared/otel.md:121).

Privacy: no ingest-time redaction - the OTLP log body is stored verbatim (`Line: log.Body().AsString()`, pkg/loghttp/push/otlp.go:577); only attribute-level drop / structured_metadata / index_label rules exist (pkg/loghttp/push/otlp_config.go:12-22; docs/sources/send-data/otel/_index.md:55-81) and the docs delegate body transforms to the collector (otel/_index.md:94-112). The delete API is registered only when compactor retention is enabled, which defaults to false (pkg/compactor/config.go:55; docs/sources/operations/storage/logs-deletion.md:43); default retention_period 0s means no automatic expiry (pkg/validation/limits.go:426) and the filesystem store never deletes on disk pressure (docs/sources/configure/storage.md:228).

Outbound telemetry is default-on: usage reports go to https://stats.grafana.org/loki-usage-report every 4h with a persistent cluster UID stored in the object store (pkg/analytics/stats.go:26; pkg/analytics/reporter.go:36,45,61,136-139). The README quick-start config and the deb/rpm /etc/loki/config.yml only comment out the opt-out (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:54-65; tools/packaging/nfpm.jsonnet:25-29); opt-out is `analytics.reporting_enabled: false` or `-reporting.enabled=false` (docs/sources/configure/usage-statistics.md:25-36).

Exposure defaults: no built-in authentication or authorization (docs/sources/setup/install/local.md:20; docs/sources/reference/loki-http-api.md:15-18); HTTP binds to all interfaces by default on port 3100 (vendor/github.com/grafana/dskit/server/server.go:193; pkg/loki/loki.go:259-260); the README quick-start config sets auth_enabled: false (single tenant 'fake', cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:1; docs/sources/operations/multi-tenancy.md:22-23) while the code default is auth.enabled=true requiring X-Scope-OrgID (pkg/loki/loki.go:159-162); admin endpoints (/config, /flush, /log_level, ingester shutdown) share the listener (loki-http-api.md:54-63,74-80); the experimental UI has no authentication (docs/sources/operations/loki-ui/_index.md:24).

Packaged defaults: the deb/rpm install cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml as /etc/loki/config.yml and auto-enable/restart a systemd unit (tools/packaging/nfpm.jsonnet:25-29; tools/packaging/loki-postinstall.sh:26-33). That config sets log_level: debug, keeps chunks/rules/index under /tmp/loki (cmd/loki/loki-local-config.yaml:6,9-15) and enables the pattern ingester with metric aggregation pushing to localhost:3100 (:42-45), so durability, verbosity and disk growth depend on the operator editing it.

Ingestion defaults can reject or drop events: per-tenant 4 MB/s (burst 6 MB), 256 KB max line, 15 label names, structured metadata 64 KB / 128 entries, reject_old_samples=true with 7d max age and 10m creation grace (pkg/validation/limits.go:317-327,351-354,491-494); oversized attributes get HTTP 400 and the entry is discarded (docs/sources/send-data/otel/_index.md:85-90).

Licensing: core is AGPL-3.0-only (README.md:140; LICENSE) with Apache-2.0 only for the subtrees in LICENSING.md:9-22; modified versions offered over a network must be made available under the same license (docs/sources/community/faqs.md:19); pkg/framedstdcopy/ is listed as Apache-2.0 but ships no license file; the project relicensed from Apache-2.0 in 2021 (faqs.md:17).

Maintenance and drift at this tag: README says Promtail is 'feature complete' while docs say EOL since March 2, 2026 (README.md:27 vs docs/sources/send-data/promtail/_index.md:12); the Loki UI doc claims Docker enables it by default but code defaults to off (pkg/ui/config.go:55); in-repo Helm chart is frozen at 6.55.0 / appVersion 3.6.7 (production/helm/loki/Chart.yaml:5-6); Simple Scalable mode is deprecated for removal in 4.0 (docs/sources/get-started/overview.md:37); .release-please-manifest.json:2 and CHANGELOG.md:3 still say 3.7.7 at tag v3.7.8; query_engine, dataobj, kafka, bloom and ingest-limits are marked experimental (pkg/loki/loki.go:95,105-106,117-122). Release assets carry SHA256SUMS only, no signatures or attestations found in this repo's workflows, and the reusable release/check workflows are pinned in an external repo (Makefile:334; .github/workflows/release.yml:10). One named default maintainer plus @grafana/loki-team (MAINTAINERS.md:1; CODEOWNERS:2); release branches 3.7.x/3.6.x get security-only dependency updates (.github/renovate.json5:22-35); no SECURITY.md.

checks.statement: /otlp/v1/logs is registered next to /loki/api/v1/push and /api/prom/push behind auth + ingestion-policy middleware.
